The dashboard shell was not bundled into this binary

This page is a placeholder. The dashboard extension embeds a prebuilt shell, and the real one is a tarball published by github.com/xraph/forge-dashboard on release. This repo's release CI downloads it and unpacks it over extensions/dashboard/shellassets/dist/ before the release build. Nothing built is ever committed there, so a binary compiled straight from a source checkout gets this page instead.

You are most likely seeing this because one of these is true:

  • You built from source yourself, without running the release CI step.
  • The CI step that fetches the tarball did not run, or failed quietly.

To fetch the real artifact by hand, follow extensions/dashboard/shellassets/dist/README.md in the forge source tree.

Nothing else about the dashboard is affected. The data contract under {basePath}/api/dashboard/v1 and every other route the extension mounts serve normally.
